audits.heroProduct: Petree Cube Zelfreinigende Kattenbak Automatische Kattenbak Bedienen via de App
gateWarnings: volwassenheid niet gemeten (nog geen qualification pass)

leaks.title: Intrusive popup blocks critical product information above fold
leaks.evidence: On both mobile and desktop, a full-screen compatibility check popup ('Past de Petree Cube v2 bij jouw kat?') appears immediately, completely hiding the product, price, and buy button. Users cannot access core purchase information without closing or completing the quiz.

leaks.title: No visible price or primary CTA above the fold on mobile
leaks.evidence: Mobile screenshot shows popup covering entire viewport. Behind it, the product title is visible but no price indicator or 'Add to Cart' button can be seen. Price only appears as '€279,-' with strikethrough '€399,-' below the popup, requiring scroll after dismissal.

leaks.title: Primary CTA text is unclear and non-actionable
leaks.evidence: The extracted primary CTA reads 'Vandaag besteld? Morgen in huis! caret-down' — this is a shipping USP, not a purchase button. Actual buy button appears to be further down. The 'Bespaar €120' badge is visible but not the main action trigger.

leaks.title: Missing review count and star rating in buy block
leaks.evidence: Structured data shows 'reviews': null, 'rating': null in ABOVE_THE_FOLD. While reviews exist lower on page, there's no visible star rating or review count near product title/price on mobile or desktop first screen.

leaks.title: Promotional urgency lacks context and credibility
leaks.evidence: Countdown timer shows '04u 12m 32s' with 'Summer Sale - Tot €150 korting' but no clear end date, stock indicator, or reason for urgency. 'Preorder-batch 21% beschikbaar' visible on desktop but not explained in context.

gateWarnings: volwassenheid niet gemeten (nog geen qualification pass)

leaks.title: No product reviews or star rating displayed
leaks.evidence: Data shows 'reviews': null, 'rating': null in ATF. JSON mentions 'klanten' and 'ervaring' in testimonials but no visible star rating or review count in screenshots

leaks.title: Critical product information hidden below fold
leaks.evidence: Above fold only shows product image, title, price and quantity selector. Key selling points (app connectivity, sensor safety, automatic cleaning cycle) only mentioned in FAQ section further down

leaks.title: Weak CTA copy lacks urgency or value
leaks.evidence: Primary CTA reads 'Toevoegen aan winkelwagen' - generic add to cart. Discount badge shows 'Bespaar €119,05' but no time limitation or stock scarcity mentioned

leaks.title: Missing lifestyle context and usage demonstration
leaks.evidence: Product gallery shows 6 product-only images (white background studio shots). No images of cats using it, size comparison with regular litter box, or home environment integration

leaks.title: Vague shipping threshold creates confusion
leaks.evidence: Trust badge states 'Gratis verzending vanaf €25' but product costs €179.95. This creates unnecessary cognitive load - is shipping free or not for THIS product?

gateWarnings: volwassenheid niet gemeten (nog geen qualification pass)

leaks.title: Price completely hidden on mobile above fold
leaks.evidence: Mobile screenshot shows product image, title, and CTA visible but no price whatsoever in first viewport. Desktop shows €199,00 EUR with €349,00 strikethrough, but mobile user cannot see pricing without scrolling

leaks.title: Generic CTA lacks urgency despite promotional context
leaks.evidence: CTA reads 'Aan winkelwagen toevoegen' (mobile) and 'Aan winkelwagen toevoegen' (desktop green button). Page has 'EXTRA KORTING!', 'BEST SELLER', 'ZOMER SALE', 'Nu op voorraad!' signals but CTA is completely neutral

leaks.title: Weak product storytelling and benefit communication
leaks.evidence: Subtitle is promotional ('VOORDEEL set van NL & BE. Morgen in huis...') but doesn't explain what makes this self-cleaning litter box better. No visible feature bullets, benefit list, or problem-solution framing above fold. Desktop shows 'ZELFREINIGENDE KATTENBAK XXL' headline but storytelling starts below fold

leaks.title: Trust badges lack context and hierarchy
leaks.evidence: Trust elements mentioned: 'gratis verzending', '30 dagen', 'garantie', 'klantenservice', 'trustpilot'. Desktop shows 'Reviews: Uitstekend' accordion but no visible star rating or review count in buyblock. Mobile shows fragmented trust signals in delivery text

leaks.title: Product imagery lacks educational/lifestyle context
leaks.evidence: Product media shows complete set bundle with accessories (litter, mat, waste bin, tofu litter bags) but all images appear to be packshot/studio style. No visible lifestyle imagery, size demonstration, or 'how it works' visual storytelling in gallery

audits.heroProduct: Cellavi Kattenbak Zelfreinigend– Automatische Kattenbak – XXL – Voor Grote Katten
gateWarnings: volwassenheid niet gemeten (nog geen qualification pass)

leaks.title: Critically low social proof volume (1 review for €194 product)
leaks.evidence: 5-star rating shown but only '1 beoordeling' visible on mobile and desktop. High-ticket product (€194.99) with premium positioning but minimal customer validation.

leaks.title: Mobile first viewport lacks price/CTA visibility
leaks.evidence: On mobile (390px), user sees announcement bar, large hero image, and gallery thumbnails. Price (€194.99) and CTA appear below the fold after scrolling past full product image and breadcrumb.

leaks.title: Missing price anchoring and value justification for premium product
leaks.evidence: €194.99 shown with -22% discount (was €249.99), but no context on savings over time (cat litter reduction, time saved), competitor comparison, or ROI framing for this premium category.

leaks.title: Weak call-to-action language for high-ticket considered purchase
leaks.evidence: Desktop CTA is 'IN WINKELWAGEN' in yellow/gold button. Mobile shows 'In winkelwagen'. Generic ecommerce language for €195 product requiring significant consideration and trust-building.

leaks.title: Desktop buyblock lacks urgency and scarcity signals
leaks.evidence: Desktop shows price, 3 USPs, payment badges, delivery info, but no stock indicator, limited-time discount countdown, or purchase momentum signals. Static presentation for discounted premium product.
